entries.1a1101a2e2db84e2: This business manufactures and sells products for general consumers, including mineral water, flavored beverages and foods. In Japan, Otsuka Shokuhin Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells consumer products, and overseas, it manufactures and sells mineral water mainly through CG Roxane LLC and Alma S.A. (both affiliates). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥34,610 million, the smallest of the four reportable segments. Its main products are the mineral water Crystal Geyser, born in California; the unsweetened and unflavored straight tea Shinbino Java Tea Straight; the vitamin soft drink Match; the California wine RIDGE; the retort food for retail sale Bon Curry; and the food series My Size, which offers calorie control. Sales volume of Crystal Geyser grew, mainly through e-commerce, while Japan's mineral water market declined slightly. Sales volume of Match also grew, as awareness and drinking experience rose through measures targeting mainly high school students. The number of employees was 590 (as of December 31, 2025).

entries.91fec9127db60efc: This business, named “Nutraceuticals,” a coined term combining Nutrition and Pharmaceuticals, manufactures and sells functional beverages, quasi-drugs, dietary supplements and other products developed on a scientific basis. In Japan, the business centers on Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., which handles manufacturing and sales as well as purchase-and-resale sales; overseas, it mainly manufactures and sells through PharmaBite LLC, Deiya Foods Inc., PT Amerta Indah Otsuka and Nutrition et Santé SAS. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥577,621 million, the second largest after the Medical-Related Business. Its product groups are presented in three categories aligned with social issues, and revenue increased in all three compared with the prior year. “Herushia Raifu” (“Nature Made,” “MegaFood,” “Calorie Mate”) ¥234,721 million (up 7.0%); “Climate and Environmental Risk” (“Pocari Sweat,” “OS-1,” “Deiya” and brands of Nutrition et Santé) ¥201,665 million (up 1.6%); and “Women’s Health” (“Ekueru,” “Bonafaido,” “Yukora,” “Inā Shigunaru,” “Sakurae”) ¥60,800 million (up 7.4%). In the United States, “Nature Made” grew sales through e-commerce and large retailers, supported by trust in the brand and its quality, and in North America the plant-derived supplement “Thermella (Sāmera)” grew. “Pocari Sweat” began official sales in India in July 2025 and in Nigeria in November. The number of employees was 9,625 as of December 31, 2025.

entries.caabad37cce47092: This business researches, develops, manufactures and sells therapeutic drugs and infusion solutions, and is the central business with the largest revenue among the four [[term:segment|reportable segments]] of Otsuka Holdings Co., Ltd. In Japan, Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Taiho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell therapeutic drugs, while clinical nutrition such as infusion solutions is handled by Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc., EN Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and others. Overseas, Otsuka America Pharmaceutical, Inc., Taiho Oncology, Inc., Otsuka Pharmaceutical Europe Ltd. and others sell therapeutic drugs, and the two domestic companies export therapeutic drugs to these overseas companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,744,234 million (up 7.1% year on year), and all reportable segments saw revenue increase. Revenue by product was as follows: the antipsychotic “Rexulti” ¥331,338 million (up 23.9%); the aripiprazole long-acting injectables “Abilify Maintena” and “Abilify Asimtufii” combined ¥259,290 million (“Abilify Asimtufii” up 83.7%); the V2 receptor antagonist “Samsca/Jinarc” ¥221,910 million (down 21.1%); clinical nutrition ¥190,828 million; and the antineoplastic “Lonsurf” ¥109,279 million (up 4.7%). “Rexulti” saw prescriptions rise in the United States as disease awareness and information activities were strengthened for major depressive disorder and agitation associated with Alzheimer’s-type dementia, and in Japan prescriptions increased significantly after it obtained approval in September 2024 for agitation associated with Alzheimer’s-type dementia. “Samsca/Jinarc” decreased: in the United States, generic drugs were launched in April 2025 after the exclusive marketing period for the treatment of autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) ended, and in Europe and Japan it was also affected by generic drugs. The number of employees was 22,897 as of December 31, 2025.

entries.ff5faac9c9e52dab: This segment groups together chemical products, measuring instruments, warehousing and transportation, and other products and services apart from pharmaceuticals and beverages and foods; it is one of the reportable segments named “Other Businesses.” Otsuka Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products, Otsuka Electronics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells measuring instruments (liquid crystal and spectroscopy businesses), Otsuka Packaging Industry Co., Ltd. makes paper containers, and Otsuka Techno Co., Ltd. makes synthetic resin molded products, which they supply to group companies in Japan. Otsuka Warehouse Co., Ltd. stores and ships products of Japanese group companies such as Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. and Taiho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., as well as products of companies outside the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥112,426 million; the functional chemicals field rose slightly due to the company making hakkai Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary, and the transportation and warehousing field increased due to the acquisition of new customers. The number of employees was 3,143 as of December 31, 2025.
